evidence.name: Screen field: Color of the completed portion
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Color of the completed portion" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Color of the completed portion
sections.description: Color of the filled part of the progress bar that grows as the sequence advances, signaling completion to the user. Defaults to green (#4CAF50). Use your brand accent or a clearly positive color, and keep strong contrast against the empty track so progress reads instantly.
